# OMP NInfer

> Durable local inference for coding agents: the qualified local inference appliance for
> Oh My Pi. Qwen3.8 27B via the NInfer engine on one NVIDIA RTX 5090, 4090, or 3090, with
> restart-resumable OpenAI Responses continuation state. Community project; not affiliated
> with Oh My Pi, Qwen, or NVIDIA.

## Canonical documents

- [Canonical facts](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/main/docs/FACTS.md): entity, fit, guarantees, measured proof, limitations
- [Decision guide](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/main/docs/DECISION_GUIDE.md): when to choose this vs Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM
- [Quickstart](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/main/docs/QUICKSTART.md): lane selection and install
- [Compatibility](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/main/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md): qualified client/runtime combinations
- [Benchmarks](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/main/docs/BENCHMARKS.md): method and receipt-bound numbers
- [Security](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/main/docs/SECURITY.md): boundaries and support rules
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/main/docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md): named failure signatures
